svg.title: What runs again after an edit to section 1
svg.desc: 3 section columns and three lanes. Every section is a page section in every lane. In the narrate lane, section 1 is voiced, and sections 2, 3 are cached. A plain build records every page section. A build with --section 1 records section 1 and keeps the other recordings. The assemble bar spans every section.
svg.text: Every section is cut and joined into one mp4.
